mapper.insert: INSERT INTO counselor_class (counselor_id, class_id, role_type, assigned_at) VALUES (#{counselorId}, #{classId}, #{roleType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM counselor_class WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM counselor_class ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{pageQuery.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageQuery.start}

SELECT c.id, c.class_code, c.class_name, c.college_id, c.major_id, (SELECT m.major_name FROM major m WHERE m.id = c.major_id) AS major_name, c.enrollment_year, c.student_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM class_info c WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM counselor_class cc WHERE cc.class_id = c.id AND cc.counselor_id = #{counselorId} ) ORDER BY c.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM counselor_class WHERE counselor_id = #{counselorId} AND class_id = #{classId} AND id != #{excludeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE counselor_class SET counselor_id = #{counselorId}, class_id = #{classId}, role_type = #{roleType} WHERE id = #{id}
